text: Sydney Seals Freediving Club is not-for-profit and volunteer run, to support the development and growth of freedivers in Sydney Australia and surrounding regions. We are an affiliated Club of the Australian Freediving Association (AFA) established in early 2025, Sydney Australia (Eora).

text: Join our programmed pool sessions to progress disciplines, improve breathhold, and underwater skills in a safe setting. Certified beginners and all levels are welcome.

Pool training is offered with coached and uncoached sessions, located in Marrickville and Randwick on a weekday. There is an instructor, assistant instructor, or experienced member present to ensure the safety of participants.
The fee paid to the club cover the cost of lane hire and pool entry, with an exception at Marrickville where you pay pool entry separately (fitness passes may cover your entry for Inner West pools!).
Become a member and then contact us to express your interest to join pool training. If you're already a member, book training below or on the app.

join.intro: Want to become a member of Sydney Seals? We’re sealiously excited! (Yes, expect many more seal puns). Membership covers one year with Sydney Seals and the AFA, which you need to compete in any AFA freediving competition in Australia and participate in club activities.
join.outro: As a not-for-profit, all fees to the club go back into our objectives – that is, facilitating freediving!
